value.title: After compacting a seat with a live holding, wake it (F111)

sections.name: body
sections.value: pm-001's F111 (2026-11-08): wildcat held coder/215 for ~17h doing nothing because a compaction ended its turn and nothing woke it. Rules: (1) After a compaction completes (session.compaction_complete in the seat's events.jsonl, or the footer drops) on a seat holding a live instance (coder/<n>, reviewer/<pr>, security, performance, ...), send it one normal send naming its holding and the handover path: 'PA: compaction done. You hold <role>/<inst>; re-read <handover> and resume <next action>.' (2) In every round, flag seats with live holdings and no own event for over an hour (pij-rs --json state <seat> last_event_at, joined with pij directory --json holders), unless the card says it is deliberately waiting on verdicts or a packet. Also, from bobcat 08 Nov: tell seats the handshake is one-off, or they re-send 'handover ready' after every new packet.
